messages:
maria (release lead): Quick heads up — we need a fastpass to push a small gateway hotfix to prod eu-west1. Rolling errors: increase in 504 spike on embed/gateway at peak. Patch is small (fixes upstream header parsing) and CI + e2e passed. Requesting expedited approval + pin to v2.3.7-hotfix. Short plan below.

deploy-bot: Deploy job created: jobs/deploy-gateway/6543210987. CI: green, e2e: green, smoke: ok. Canary plan configured: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (10m steps). Auto-rollback hook: enabled.

jamie (oncall): oncall ack, can you paste rollback criteria? I'll be watching the dashboards.

maria (release lead): Rollback criteria: if canary window sees p95 latency > 500ms OR error rate > 1% sustained for 5m OR regressions on tokenization errors (seen in last 30m). SRE will trigger rollback.

sanjeev (eng-sre): I approve fastpass if we keep strict canary gating. I'll run alerts: create alert with 2m evaluation on error rate and p95. If either breachs threshold, I'll cut traffic back to 0% and trigger rollback. Also request we pin image tag and keep old image ready in registry.

elaine (prod-eng): I can own the traffic swap. Proposed staged timing: start at 02:40 UTC with 2% for 10m, if green bump to 10% for 10m, then 50% for 10m, then 100%. If anything noisy, immediate step-down.

maria (release lead): Release notes blurb for CS/ops: "Gateway: fix header parse bug causing intermittent 504s under specific client header combos. Rolling deploy; expected negligible functional changes."", will paste to #customer-notify if green.

micah (customer-success): Noted — we have 3 paid tenants who reported errors. I'll stand by to notify them if we need to engage and will update once 50% is reached.

maria (release lead): Pin command and rollback snippets:

```
# pin to hotfix tag
/infra pin-service gateway --image inference-gateway:v2.3.7-hotfix --region eu-west1

# rollback (if needed)
/infra rollback-service gateway --to-image inference-gateway:v2.3.6
```

jamie (oncall): approve :thumbsup: I give fastpass.

sanjeev (eng-sre): SRE approves, standing by on alerts. I'll annotate the incident board and hold the rollback toggle. :eyes:

ana (pm): typo fix: "maria" -> please also add minimal changelog entry in the release notes doc. Approve for rollout.

maria (release lead): small update: added changelog line, created release note draft: https://internal/release-notes/6543210987 (private)

deploy-bot: Deployment started: canary 2% -> job id jobs/deploy-gateway/6543210987/canary1. Logs: https://ci/reports/jobs/6543210987

elaine (prod-eng): canary 2% live. Monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards/prod/gateway/eu-west1. I'll report at +10m.

jamie (oncall): seeing initial metrics — latency stable, error rate nominal. continue.

micah (customer-success): I'm pinging the 3 tenants to say we're rolling a fix now.

deploy-bot: Canary success: 2% window passed. Scaling to 10%.

elaine (prod-eng): 10% live. so far stable. bumping to 50% in 10m unless SRE calls it.

sanjeev (eng-sre): holding a watch. no triggers yet. :white_check_mark:

maria (release lead): Thx team. If 50% stays green we'll finish roll to 100% after final 10m. All approvals recorded.

deploy-bot: Canary progress: 50% -> success. Finalizing roll to 100% now.

elaine (prod-eng): 100% done. Observability: p95 down ~20ms, errors back to baseline. Closing loop and posting release note to #customer-notify.

micah (customer-success): Notified affected tenants — they confirm recovery. Great work. :tada:

maria (release lead): Closing thread. Fastpass approved and executed. I'll open a short postmortem if any followups, otherwise marking as resolved. Thanks all.
